infographic.title: Four Jobs a Valve Can Do
infographic.alt: Infographic showing the four main functions of the types of industrial valves
steps: Start or stop flow completely: gate, ball and butterfly valves.
Throttle and control flow: globe and control valves.
Stop reverse flow automatically: check valves.
Relieve excess pressure: safety and relief valves.
